purpose: A labeled AI-generated result with optional confidence, provenance, feedback, and regeneration.
behaviorProvider: Native section with shared AiLabel, ConfidenceBadge and AiFeedback.

component: Mark material visibly as AI generated. An optional title renders as h3 and labels the section; loading exposes aria-busy and disables feedback/regeneration controls.
Render supplied confidence and provenance without inferring or verifying either. Show the footer only when provenance, feedback or regenerate inputs are present.
host: Own generation, provenance, confidence calibration and feedback persistence. Present generated content as reviewable information.
Use an appropriate accessible section name when title is omitted; own document heading hierarchy.

requirements.statement: Mark material visibly as AI generated. An optional title renders as h3 and labels the section; loading exposes aria-busy and disables feedback/regeneration controls.
Render supplied confidence and provenance without inferring or verifying either. Show the footer only when provenance, feedback or regenerate inputs are present.

AiFeedback uses the controlled feedback value when supplied, otherwise local selection. Positive and negative buttons expose aria-pressed and invoke onFeedback; regeneration is an independent optional action.
AiLabel uses a unique gradient id and observes prefers-reduced-motion; server rendering starts without gradient motion.
Own generation, provenance, confidence calibration and feedback persistence. Present generated content as reviewable information.
Use an appropriate accessible section name when title is omitted; own document heading hierarchy.

Use ai group tokens for owned presentation, preserve genuine nested component ownership, and verify the same geometry across Fundamental and Fundamental Floating in light/dark. Keep the documented semantics and state model when composing or extending this family.

limitations: AI visual treatment and confidence do not certify correctness, safety or approval.
Feedback is not automatically persisted or sent to a model.
Authored source coverage is separate from executed interaction, visual, accessibility and consumer-package evidence.
